summary: A bold pinky ring with a certified 1.00 ct oval lab-grown diamond set into a sculptural 14K gold profile — a reminder to rise, shine, and take up space.
description:
A bold reminder to rise, shine, and take up space. The Rise Ring pairs a certified 1.00 ct oval lab-grown diamond with a smooth, sculptural 14K gold setting designed for pinky-ring presence.

Natural diamond and coloured gemstone versions are available by request.

details.Other stones: Natural diamond and coloured gemstone options by request

care: Store separately and clean gently with a soft jewellery cloth to protect the polished gold and stone setting.
shipping: Made to order; ring size, gold colour, production timing, and insured delivery are confirmed in writing before payment.
